title: 都说星链是核心：分析师却指发射，SpaceX估值会重估吗？

segments.en: First of all thank you for having me really. That's a great question I'd say off the bat SpaceX IPO to great expectations and it's not clear to us and I would be remiss not to
segments.zh: 首先，非常感谢你的邀请。这是个好问题。我要说的是，SpaceX的IPO承载了很高的期望，但我们并不清楚，而且我必须提到我的同事尼克和克雷格，他们和我共同报道SpaceX。

segments.en: mention Nick Del Dayo and Craig Moff at my colleagues co-cover SpaceX with me and our point of view is that we're probably not going to hear all that much tomorrow to help us reset those
segments.zh: 我们的观点是，明天我们可能不会听到太多能帮助我们重新设定这些预期的信息。

segments.en: expectations and the way that we think about projections and forecasts versus the rest of consensus that look we're well below consensus on the AI and connectivity segments of the business

segments.en: for a number of reasons that we can talk about and tomorrow we're probably not going to hear anything that's going to either prove or disprove whose forecast. We'll talk about the AI
segments.zh: 明天我们可能不会听到任何能证明或反驳我们预测的信息。我们来谈谈AI和连接业务。

segments.en: and connectivity and just give me a sense here of how you value this company Julie in terms of like I mean is it a rocket launch company is it an AI company is it you know Starlink is it all
segments.zh: 朱莉，请给我一个你如何估值这家公司的概念。它是一家火箭发射公司，还是AI公司，还是星链，还是所有这些？

segments.en: the above SpaceX in our view sort of has almost a bit of an identity crisis if you think about it
segments.zh: 在我们看来，SpaceX几乎有点身份认同危机，如果你想想看，他们有这么多不同的业务部分。

segments.en: they have so many different parts of the business and for us the crown jewel is really the launch
segments.zh: 对我们来说，皇冠上的明珠是发射业务。
